title: Erdős-Hajnal conjecture beyond five-vertex graphs
summary: In 1989, Erdős and Hajnal conjectured that for any graph $H$, there is a constant $c=c(H)>0$ such that every $n$-vertex graph $G$ with no induced copies of $H$ contains a clique or an independent set of size at least $n^{c}$. This conjecture, known as the Erdős-Hajnal conjecture, is a central open problem in combinatorics and listed as one of the top 10 Erdős problems by Bloom on the Erdős problem website https://www.erdosproblems.com/.
